projects.title: UniVerse
projects.description: Welcome to the digital campus quad!Whether you're looking for study groups, campus events, or just want to share your thoughts, UniVerse is built for you.Some features- Verified university emails only, everyone you interact with is a college student- Location-based posts to find what's happening on your campus- See posts from your own campus community, or switch to the global feed to connect with students across all universities

projects.title: Pola
projects.description: Pola stitches together your favorite video memories to create a montage of your life. Simply create a project, upload short clips, and press stitch! Rearrange clip order if needed, and change color theme to your liking.- Created iOS app Pola.- Used React Native with FFmpeg. Made intuitive app UI.- Managed local device file storage.

projects.title: UIUC Bus Tracker
projects.description: Have a class across campus? Want to visit downtown Champaign?Try the perfect bus app for University of Illinois students! Look at any bus stop and all the routes. View the map and track buses around campus. Plan trips anywhere in Champaign-Urbana area. Star your favorite bus stops and view ones nearby. Get notified for bus departures.- Created a bus tracker for UIUC students, presenting data on over 2,000 bus stops.- Tracks active bus routes and allows users to plan trips. Displays stops near the user’s location. Shows where and when buses arrive, and their destinations.- Allows users to plan trips through multiple buses, with options to minimize time, distance walked, or amount of route transfers.- Completely free!

projects.title: Green Thumb Network
projects.description: ‎Welcome to Green Thumb Network! Use our app to start the perfect garden. Hours of research already done for you, compiled into one app!- Designed, developed, and launched Green Thumb Network, an app for novice gardeners which provides gardening information on over 40 crops, such as fertilizer type, temperature, recommended sunlight amount, soil pH levels, and growing times.- Implemented and optimized key features such as current local weather, amount of local sunlight in the day, a to-do list, gardening tips and tricks, and fertilizer information.- Generated 50+ downloads within the first 3 days after its release, resulting in 30+ 5-star reviews.
